Subject: AI-powered resident service platform for the City of Riverbend

Hi Dana,

I lead public sector partnerships at CivReply Systems, Inc. We build an
AI assistant that answers resident questions on city websites and phone
lines. It is live today in 14 municipal governments, including the City
of Fairfax Falls, VA and Bexley County, OH.

A few facts about us:

- Founded in 2016, headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Delaware C-corp,
  registered to do business in 22 states.
- SOC 2 Type II audited annually since 2019 (report available under NDA).
- StateRAMP Authorized at the Moderate impact level.
- On a Sourcewell cooperative contract, so your procurement team can
  buy without a new RFP.
- 63 full-time employees. Our CTO, Maria Ostrowski, previously ran the
  digital services team for the State of Ohio.

Cities using CivReply resolve about 40 percent of inbound service
requests without staff involvement, based on our 2024 customer survey.

Could we set up a 30-minute call next week? I can share references from
governments your size.

Best,
Tom Nguyen
VP Public Sector, CivReply Systems, Inc.
tom.nguyen@civreply.example.com | civreply.example.com
